newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity to launch international fund.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity to launch international fund.

text.p: Fidelity Investments' Robert Pozen, president of the company's mutual fund group, said Wednesday the company will launch an international capital appreciation fund later this year.
Pozen disclosed the plan while talking to reporters early Wednesday about the performance of Fidelity's mutual funds.
"We have a plans to add an international capital appreciation fund later this year," Pozen said. "We look at new fund ideas on a regular basis.
He said the company has been concentrating on improving the performance of its diversified funds in recent months, but may add additional funds later.
"We will gradually be adding funds," he added.
